visual_nodes.graph_summary: Figure 3 — Model architecture for depth-based person re-identification. The diagram shows a sequential processing pipeline where input frames I_t and I_{t+1} are processed through frame-level feature embedding f_CNN(θ_g) to generate g_t and g_{t+1}. These features feed into a recurrent LSTM module f_LSTM(θ_h) and a Reinforced Temporal Attention (RTA) unit f_w(θ_w), which outputs frame weights w_t and w_{t+1}. The LSTM state h_t and h_{t+1} are passed to a classifier f_c(θ_c) to produce class predictions c_t and c_{t+1}. The RTA unit is highlighted in red.
